reference_sql:
WITH payment_counts AS (  -- one row per subscription that started in July or August 2025
  SELECT s.subscription_id, s.plan_name, COUNT(*) AS n_payments
  FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  WHERE s.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-08-31'
  GROUP BY s.subscription_id, s.plan_name
)
SELECT plan_name,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n_payments) AS median_payments
FROM payment_counts
GROUP BY plan_name

SELECT t.plan_name, MEDIAN(t.n_payments) AS median_payments
FROM (
  -- one row per subscription that started in July or August 2025
  SELECT s.subscription_id, s.plan_name, COUNT(*) AS n_payments
  FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  WHERE s.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-08-31'
  GROUP BY s.subscription_id, s.plan_name
) AS t
GROUP BY t.plan_name

solver.query:
WITH pc AS (
  SELECT s.subscription_id, s.plan_name, COUNT(p.payment_id) AS n_payments
  FROM subscriptions s
  LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  WHERE s.start_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND s.start_date <= DATE '2025-08-31'
  GROUP BY s.subscription_id, s.plan_name
)
SELECT plan_name, MEDIAN(n_payments) AS median_payments
FROM pc
GROUP BY plan_name
